ROW.COLUMN: (FR/AC) CIB: Significant Change from Previous Average Debit Activity

Transaction activity in any given account varies widely and changes for a multitude of reasons, often allowing fraudulent activity to go unnoticed. A sudden change in transaction activity in certain products, such as checks, ATM cash withdrawals, or outbound electronic funds transfers could signal theft or account takeover. This scenario monitors various accounts' debit transactions and detects significant changes from the average over previous monthly transaction activity.
